entries.en: column, pillar
[manuscript defective; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 汉、闽南、官话三栏皆[空]，仅存西语残行 'Cbico ch fanco'，无法定谳。

entries.en: to set out / prepare wine and a feast
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:設/沒]，依西语 Combibe/aderecarlo 及闽南 pierchiù（排设酒）取'设酒'义。

entries.en: to invite (someone) to do something
to distribute / divide out something
entries.notes: 闽南音栏 T99 污损，字义依汉字'分'与西语 repartiendo 而定。

entries.en: to invite to lodge / to host overnight
entries.notes: '晋'疑为'进/留'类字之形讹，依西语 hospedar 与闽南 lau 定为留宿义。

entries.en: to invite / entreat (by asking)
to summon / lead many people together
entries.notes: 闽南音栏 T99 污损；依汉字'率'与西语 conbidar a muchos（召集众人）释义。

entries.zh: 宣请（正式延请、以礼相邀）
entries.en: to invite with courtesy / formally summon
to summon, call together one's subjects
entries.notes: 西语栏有[残]一处，文意据残句 'llamar à … alos subditos' 补足。

entries.en: to beckon / attract, invite
guest, invited one
entries.notes: 两音栏均 T99 污损，字义依汉字'客'与西语 Conbidado。

entries.en: guest, visitor

entries.zh: 排酒（整治酒席、备酒待客）
entries.en: to lay out / prepare a feast of wine
to invite a person
to invite to a drinking feast
entries.notes: 汉字栏'食請酒'与音写'chià̃ chiù'略有出入，以'请酒'为主释义。

entries.en: to invite one who is passing by (to eat)
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:盡/進]；依西语 'el que pasa'（过路之人）取邀过客义。

entries.zh: 做主人（作东、当宴请的主人）
entries.en: to act as host, to be the one who invites

entries.zh: 邀游（相邀出游、邀伴遨游）
entries.en: to invite for an excursion / outing

entries.zh: 晋不带（受邀留宿而不肯留）
entries.en: to be asked to lodge and refuse
entries.notes: '晋'字同前疑为讹形，依西语 'se hospede y el no quisiere' 定为受邀留宿而拒。

entries.zh: 让天下（让位于天下、礼让不居尊）
entries.en: to yield the empire / decline precedence to others
entries.notes: 西语 'desprincipes, desiguales' 释义晦涩，据汉字'让天下'与对音释义。

entries.zh: 让位（让出位分、让位于尊者/外邦君长）
entries.en: to yield one's place / cede the seat (to princes)
entries.notes: 西语 'de fuere'（外）文意欠明，据汉字'让位'释义。

entries.zh: 谢酒（酒席致谢、以酒答谢）
entries.en: to return thanks with a feast of wine
banquet, feast; a table laden with food
